insurer: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited
plan_name: Senior Citizens Red Carpet Health Insurance Policy

room_rent.display: 1% of SI/day (up to ₹10,000/day for higher SIs)
room_rent.note: ₹1L–₹5L: 1% of SI/day; ₹7.5L–₹10L: ₹6,000/day; ₹15L: ₹7,000/day; ₹20L: ₹8,500/day; ₹25L: ₹10,000/day. Proportionate deduction on associated expenses if higher room chosen.

icu.note: ₹1L–₹10L: up to 2% of SI per day; ₹15L–₹25L: actuals

copayment.note: Mandatory 30% co-payment applies to all claims for all insured persons

sub_limits.note: Cataract, CVA/cardiovascular/cancer/renal/long bone fractures, all major surgeries, and all modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, intravitreal injections, etc.) are subject to per-person per-policy-period caps. Surgeon/consultant fees capped at 25% of SI; other surgical expenses capped at 50% of SI per hospitalisation.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 12 months of continuous coverage from first policy inception

specific_disease_waiting.note: Extensive list including cataract, ENT, thyroid, hernia, joint replacements, gallbladder, kidney stones, gynaec conditions, prostate, varicose veins, transplants, congenital internal diseases, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Code Excl 18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording

restoration.note: No sum insured restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days prior to hospitalisation for the same condition

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation covered as 7% of hospitalisation expenses (nursing, surgeon, diagnostics, medicines) subject to per-SI caps: ₹1L–₹7.5L: ₹5,000; ₹10L–₹15L: ₹7,000; ₹20L–₹25L: ₹10,000

day_care.note: All day care procedures are covered under this policy

domiciliary.note: Home Care Treatment covered up to 10% of SI, max ₹50,000 per policy year, for specified conditions only (fever, UTI, asthma, gastroenteritis, IV chemo, palliative care, etc.)

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient hospitalisation covered up to Sum Insured; Yoga and Naturopathy require prior company approval

organ_donor.note: Organ donor expenses not mentioned in the policy wording; transplant-related surgeries are excluded under specific disease waiting period (24 months)

modern_treatments.note: Modern treatments covered (robotic surgery, oral chemo, intravitreal injections, deep brain stimulation, balloon sinuplasty, stereotactic radiosurgery, stem cell therapy, etc.) but subject to per-person per-policy-period sub-limits varying by SI

consumables.note: 68-item non-medical/consumables list explicitly excluded (List I); items subsumed into room/procedure charges also not separately payable

global_cover.note: Territorial limit: all treatments must be taken in India

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud

grace_period.note: 30 days for annual/quarterly/half-yearly; 15 days for monthly instalment mode

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or portability/migration

portability.note: IRDAI-compliant portability; credits for PED, specific waiting periods, NCB, moratorium transferable

notable_exclusions.display: 30% co-pay all claims; transplants (24mo wait); cochlear implants; dental (non-accident); EECP/chelation/hyperbaric O2; biologicals (outpatient); vaccination; refractive error <7.5D

optional_riders.note: No optional riders or add-on covers described in this policy document
